chapter.verse: Topa ’ thugenna: Hadrak gamte’ daantuah nading Topa in thukhen zo a, Damaskas khuapi in zong tuak ding hi. Israel minam khempeuh, Topa ’ aa ahih mah bangin, leitung minam khempeuh zong Topa ’ aa ahi hi.
Hadrak tawh a kigizawng Hamath zong, ama’ aa hi a, siamna a nei Tai-ar khuapi leh Sidon khuapite zong, ama’ aa mah ahi hi.
Tai-ar khuapi in galnan’na kulh bawl a, leivui zahin ngun leh kham hau a, kongzing nin zahin kiciang venvan hi.
Ahi zongin, Topa in a neih khempeuh laksakin, tuipi sungah paihsak ding a, a khuapi haltum ding hi.

Ashkelon khuapi in hih thu mu-in lau ding a, Gaza khuapi in zong gimlawh ding hi. A lametna teng bei ding ahih manin, Ekron khuapi in zong gimlawh ding hi. Gaza khuapi in a kumpipa taan ding a, Ashkelon khuapi kinusiacip ding hi.
Ashdod khuapi-ah kahbia mite teeng ding a, a kiphasak Filistia mite ka beisak ding hi.

Amaute in sa, a sisan tawh ne nawn lo ding uh a, a kikham ante zong tang ding uh hi. A suakta sun teng, keima mite suak ding uh a, Judah minam lakah beh khat bang ding uh hi. Jebus mite mah bangin Ekron khuamite zong, keima mi suak ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka gamsung ka hu ding a, galte ka nawksak kei ding hi. Ka mihingte’ thuakna mu khin ka hih manin, mi gilote ka bawlsiasak nawn kei ding hi.

Zion mite aw, nakpi takin lungdam un. Jerusalem mite aw, lungdamin awng un. En un, na kumpipa uh hong pai hi. Amah, dikna leh gupkhiatna tawh hong pai a, ahi zongin kiniamkhiatna tawh hong pai-in sin nai loh lano tungah hong tuang hi.

Gal kidona leengte, Israel gam pan beisakin, sakol galkapte, Judah gam pan ka la khia ding a, galdona-a kizang thalte, kisusia ding hi. Na kumpipa un, minamte lakah kilemna thu gen ding a, amah in, tuipi mong khat pan tuipi mong khat dong, Eufrates gunpi panin leimong dongin uk ding hi.
Sisan tawh a kikipsak, note tawh ka thuciamna hangin, na salsuahna uh keugaw gam panin, note ka hong suaktasak ding hi.
Lametna a om ta, no salte aw, ciahkik un la, a muanhuai na mun ngei uh zuankik un. Note’ thuaknasa a zah nihin, thupha ka hong piak nading, tu ni-in note kiangah ka hong gen hi.
Grik mite sim nadingin, Judah thal bangin keek-in, Israel thaltang-in ka zang ding a, Zion mite namsau-in ka zang ding hi.
Ama mite tungah Topa kilang ding a, a thaltang lot khuaphia bang ding hi. Topa Pasian in peengkul tum ding a, leitaw lam pan-a hong nung huihpi tawh va kuankhia ding hi.

Vanglianpen Topa in ama mite hu ding a, ama mite in a galte uh susia ding hi. Galdona sungah, zukham bangin awng gawp ding uh a, a galte uh’ sisan luangsak gawp ding uh hi. Biakna site, biakna tau tungah, hai-a sun tawh kibangin luangsak ding uh hi.
Tuucingpa in a tuuhonte, lauhuaina pan a hot bangin, tua ni ciangin Topa, amau’ Pasian in a mite honkhia ding hi. Kumpi lukhu tunga suangmanphate bangin, ama gam sungah a mite taang ding uh hi.
Tua thu bangzah takin hoihin nuam ding ahi hiam! Anlim nekna in tangvalte thahatsak ding a, leenggahtui thak dawnna in nungakte thadimsak ding hi.
